summary: Table of Ansible community package versions with status and their ansible-core dependency: 15.0.0 in development on core 2.22, 14.x current on 2.21, 13.x EOL in June 2026 on 2.20, and older versions unmaintained.
questions: Which ansible-core version does Ansible 14 use?
What is the latest Ansible community package version?
Which Ansible package version matches ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: Ansible package versions and core dependency
answer_card.answer_md:
| Package | Status | ansible-core |
|---|---|---|
| 15.0.0 | In development | 2.22 |
| 14.x | Current, latest | 2.21 |
| 13.x | EOL June 2026 | 2.20 |
| 12.x | Unmaintained | 2.19 |
| 11.x | Unmaintained | 2.18 |
| 10.x | Unmaintained | 2.17 |
| 9.x | Unmaintained | 2.16 |

8.x to 2.10 are also unmaintained (core 2.15 down to 2.10).
